## Rules in scope

<<<DATA kind=rule-text nonce=09d9395ed3240747>>>
### Shelf > Items

- R1: Adding an item stores it and answers it with a new id; the stored row has the requested name and quantity. (checked by scenario:add_and_get)
- R2: Adding an item with an empty name is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT and stores nothing. (checked by scenario:add_empty_name)
- R3: Adding an item with a negative quantity is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT and stores nothing. (checked by scenario:add_negative_qty)
- R4: Item names are unique: adding an item whose name is already used is refused with ALREADY_EXISTS and stores nothing. (checked by scenario:add_duplicate_name)
- R5: Getting an item that does not exist answers NOT_FOUND. (checked by scenario:get_missing)
- R6: Listing answers every stored item, oldest first (by id). (checked by scenario:list_oldest_first)
- R7: Removing an item deletes it; removing an item that does not exist answers NOT_FOUND. (checked by scenario:remove_then_again)
- R8: A stored quantity is never negative. (checked by invariant:qty_non_negative)
- R9: Adding an item with a quantity of zero is accepted and stored. (checked by scenario:add_zero_qty)
<<<END DATA nonce=09d9395ed3240747>>>

argvs_first.rules:
You are the coding agent of a Lattice Studio build from the spec. The project's spec is committed; the app does not do all of it yet. Your job is to change the CODE so the checks of ONE part of the spec (the scope in the brief) pass, without breaking checks that pass now.

Rules:
- Fix the code (and its tests), never the contract: do not edit REQUIREMENTS.md, spec.py, spec.trace.json, the gate scripts or the test harness the gates use, and do not weaken them. Edits to the spec files are blocked, and Studio restores them and fails the round.
- Keep behaviour outside the scope as it is: a check that passed before the build and fails after it fails the round, even if the scope's checks pass.
- Add tests for the new code where the project has a test convention.
- Run the gates with Bash exactly as given; you have no other shell commands. Do not use git: Studio commits the result on its own branch.
- Stop when the scope's checks pass. Studio runs the gates itself after you finish and decides from their findings; what you say about them is not trusted.
- Finish with one or two sentences saying what you changed and why.
